panels.title: Error Rate — Errors per Minute (LogQL)
panels.description: Counts ERROR-level log lines from billing-service per minute. Spikes indicate payment processing failures, voucher validation errors, or saga compensation (refund) events.

panels.title: Payment & Transaction Processing Logs (LogQL)
panels.description: Counts billing-service log lines related to payment, transaction, and refund events over 5 m, grouped by level. WARN/ERROR entries during saga fan-out indicate compensation transactions or payment gateway timeouts.

panels.title: Correlation ID Trace — Billing Request Chains (LogQL)
panels.description: Streams billing-service log lines carrying a correlationId. Enables tracing a single order-completed event through payment creation, voucher application, and refund if saga rolls back.

panels.title: HTTP Request Rate — Requests/s per Endpoint (PromQL)
panels.description: Layer 1 – Metric: http_server_requests_seconds_count | Layer 2 – Label: job=billing-service | Layer 3 – Range: [5m] | Layer 4 – Function: rate → sum by uri. Shows load distribution across transaction creation, refund, and revenue-analytics endpoints.

panels.title: Database Connection Pool — HikariCP Active vs Max (PromQL)
panels.description: Layer 1 – Metrics: hikaricp_connections_active, hikaricp_connections_max, hikaricp_connections_pending | Layer 2 – Label: job=billing-service | Layer 3 – Range: [5m] | Layer 4 – Function: max_over_time (active/pending), gauge (max). Pool exhaustion alert — billing-service using 10/10 connections during saga fan-out causes queuing and latency spikes.

panels.title: RabbitMQ Throughput — Payment Saga Events (PromQL)
panels.description: Layer 1 – Metrics: rabbitmq_published_total, rabbitmq_consumed_total | Layer 2 – Label: job=billing-service | Layer 3 – Range: [5m] | Layer 4 – Function: rate → sum by queue. Consumer lag on billing.order-completed (published > consumed by > 100) means payment transactions are not being recorded fast enough — risk of duplicate charges on retry.
